isolation_note: build-review-packet.sh only supports the native-kbd backend — it collects .kbd-orchestrator/changes/<id>/{spec.md,tasks.json,verification.md} and exits 2 with 'no artifacts found' for an openspec-backend project. Packet was assembled manually (mandate + constraints + both prior handoffs + all 5 changes) and judged by a fresh-context subagent. Weaker than a true cross-model gateway call; stated rather than hidden.
tooling_defect: adversarial-review build-review-packet.sh:487 hard-codes the native-kbd spec layout. kbd-spec explicitly supports an openspec backend, so the spec-stage vet cannot run via the normal path on any openspec project.

findings.claim: Task 3.1 writes decision-log.md, which is absent from the declared scope; gate 4.1's git diff --stat would flag the legitimate write as unintended.
findings.disposition: FIXED — decision-log.md added to scope in both proposal and tasks.

findings.claim: G-7 was carried as a prerequisite through both prior handoffs but no change covers it or records an explicit deferral.
findings.disposition: FIXED — task 4.1 now records the deferral as a decision-log entry, gate 5.2 asserts it by grep. Deferral is now a choice on the record, not an omission.

findings.claim: p7-05 tasks 1.4/1.5 read assets/scaffold/agui/ paths by name, but p7-03 and p7-04 never declare those paths as a downstream contract. Renaming any of them silently breaks p7-05 with no gate catching it.
findings.disposition: FIXED — explicit 'Path contract (consumed downstream)' note added to both p7-03 and p7-04.

findings.claim: package.json ordering constraint stated only in p7-04, not p7-03 — asymmetric and undiscoverable from p7-03's side.
findings.disposition: FIXED — matching shared-file note added to p7-03.

findings.claim: Task 1.1 requires re-verifying the pre-1.0 enum but defines no action on mismatch, so an agent has no defined branch if the package moved.
findings.disposition: FIXED — task 1.2 added: HALT and escalate; a mismatch is a re-analysis trigger, not a mechanical retry.

findings.claim: Three tasks say 'confirm with the operator' with no defined interface and no verifiable artifact, unlike gate 5.2's grep check for the G-7 entry.
findings.disposition: FIXED — task 1.2 records a timestamped '## Operator confirmation' entry; gate 5.3 asserts it by grep. An unanswered prompt is explicitly not consent.

note: All six findings across both rounds were verified correct and applied. The revision cap was reached, so no third round ran; nothing was left outstanding at the cap.
